touristAppeal.label: Worth a Visit
touristAppeal.summary: A worthwhile Welsh market town led by Bailey Hill, its historic street pattern, market tradition and a useful concentration of cultural and heritage interest within the settlement.

townGuide.headline: Mold: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
